scope: Primary-source statements inspected for this research pass. A source-qualified input is not a claim of independent verification of the source's full proof or formal development.

sources.title: Almost linear valuation budgets for pointwise modular routing in Collatz inverse trees
sources.author: Lyapunov Weaver
sources.location: Lemma11 equation143 and actual inverse consumer equations145--146
sources.use: SOURCE-QUALIFIED INPUT: multiplicity of actual legal unit inverse blocks at fixed total valuation2b, with uniformly bounded real offset. The new support-dimension proof is reconstructed separately in this checkpoint.
sources.limit: Deep routing proof not independently reconstructed or formalized here. The auxiliary Frostman law is not identified with the canonical boundary probability.

sources.title: Geometry, integer fibres, and dyadic equidistribution of the joint Collatz affine law
sources.author: Lyapunov Weaver
sources.location: Section9.2 F3; Section10 S2 and Section10.1 S4--S6
sources.use: SOURCE-QUALIFIED TESTED INPUT: canonical real-fibre context and uniform product-ball mass estimate for the independent stationary joint affine law. The direct entropy transfer was tested with its actual conditioning cost retained.
sources.limit: The complete counted-coalescence and trace dependency chain was not rebuilt. Full dimension of the bulk law gives no asserted moving ordinary-fibre entropy bound.

sources.title: Ternary Syracuse laws: real localization, clock stability, and critical regularity
sources.author: Lyapunov Weaver
sources.location: AppendixB, Theorem16 B1--B2; AppendixC, Theorem18 C1--C3
sources.use: SOURCE-QUALIFIED TESTED INPUT: every finite ternary moment after a bounded real restriction and the explicit dyadic-shell norm. Applied at the unchanged actual root and source clock, it yields an inequality compatible with escape, not a contradiction.
sources.limit: Central exact division totals do not cover arbitrary actual valuation clocks. No ordinary-point early-depth trace comparison was imported. Full external mixing proof not audited.

sources.title: Ternary harmonic moments and Collatz orbit occupation
sources.author: Lyapunov Weaver
sources.location: Sections5.1--5.6, harmonic moment limit, fixed-floor tail and stopping clock
sources.use: CHECKED, NOT A CLOSING INPUT: the harmonic-moment limit detects individual non-eventually-periodic trajectories, but its required vanishing is not established by the displayed stopping-floor bounds.
sources.limit: The available decay-rate characterization still requires a uniform repeat clock. The union of forward orbits from a finite seed set was not replaced by its entire predecessor basins.

sources.title: A power-saving bound, uniform in the endpoint, for Collatz orbits that stay above a fixed barrier
sources.author: Hiroyuki Nashida
sources.location: Primary repository README, theorem and proof-status declaration
sources.use: CHECKED, NOT IMPORTED: the stated bound E(X,N0) <= K*N0^(-c')*X saves a power of the barrier parameter and remains linear in the endpoint cutoff X.
sources.limit: The author's formal-verification claim is recorded as a claim. This pass did not rebuild that external Lean project, and did not treat this bound as a fixed-floor sublinear-in-X theorem.
